prompts.initial:
Create a lovely, refined original ink-and-watercolor editorial illustration for a family story about an off-season Saturday morning breakfast during a Wells, Maine trip. This is illustrative atmosphere, not a documentary picture of an exact picnic location.

Composition: generous landscape 3:2 canvas, one coherent fully visible watercolor vignette, softly irregular feathered transparent edges with room around all the artwork. In the upper third, on clear quiet negative space, beautiful highly legible dark-navy editorial serif lettering reads EXACTLY:
"Waterside Breakfast"
"in Wells"
Below that, a smaller elegant handwritten line reads EXACTLY:
"A little off-season pleasure"
Carefully proofread every word. Balanced typographic hierarchy; no other lettering.

Scene: an inviting, naturally proportioned weathered wooden picnic table beside quiet coastal Maine water, viewed at a gentle three-quarter angle. Three modest place settings with proper ivory ceramic plates with slender navy rims and real clear drinking glasses brought from home. Two taller glasses hold creamy eggnog cold brew with lovely subtle coffee-and-cream swirls; a smaller glass holds pale ivory eggnog on its own. Assorted golden bakery muffins and a couple of chocolate-frosted donuts with a few tiny sprinkles sit on the plates. A casually folded navy-and-cream linen napkin, warm wood grain, soft glass reflections. No coffee steam: these are cold drinks. The food should look appetizing and naturally sized, not oversized or cartoonish.

Beyond the table, a tranquil sweep of blue-grey water, muted golden saltmarsh grasses, a distant low pine-green shoreline, and a little russet autumn foliage under luminous cool late-autumn morning light. Intimate, peaceful and quietly joyful. Refined New England character: Nantucket meets Vermont, warm cream, navy ink, pine green, subtle cranberry and honey-gold accents. Expressive transparent watercolor washes with visible pigment blooms, delicate fine pen detail, accurate perspective, artisanal paper-like brush texture within the pigment, graceful open space. Lovely original magazine illustration, sophisticated and age-respectful.

Keep the full table-and-breakfast vignette inside the canvas; no cropping, frame, rounded mask, decorative border, artificial drop shadow, background rectangle, glossy 3D rendering, flat clip art or sticker style. No people, no synthetic family stand-ins, no animals, no logos, no branded packages, no signs, no invented recognizable landmark, no lighthouse, no buildings, no access-route depiction. Transparent background outside the organically edged painting and lettering.
